In summary, our research is concerned with
the synthesis of highly crystalline and well dispersed ZnO nanoparticles by refluxing zinc precursor in diethylene and triethylene glycols for their antimicrobial applications.
the synthesis and characterization of zinc oxidenanoparticles by polyol chemistry for antimicrobial and antibacterial applications.
the synthesis of ZnO nanoparticles by polyol method and its antibacterial and antibofilm activity against pathogenic microorganism.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the present work is a successful attempt in synthesizing ZnO nanoparticles with different size and shape and their antibacterial and antibofilm activities.
polyol chemistry is a facile and cost effective method for the synthesis of ZnO nanoparticles with controlled particle size which exhibited promising antibacterial and antibacterial activity.

ZnO nanoparticles with 15 nm size prepared by refluxing of zinc acetate dihyrate in diethylene glyol for 3 h in the presence of sodium acetate exhibited maximum antibacterial and antibiobiofilm activity against S. aureus (NCIN 2654) and P. vulgaris (NCIN 2613) respectively and can be used for the treatment of infections caused by S. aureus and P. vulgar is.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have synthesized and characterized zinc oxide nanoparticles and their antimicrobials activities against pathogenic microbes.
we successfully prepared ZnO NPs with different sizes by using diethylene glycol and triethylene glycols as reducing and capping agents.
ZnO nanoparticles prepared by polyol chemistry are potential antimicrobial agents and can be used in various biomedical applications.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the polyol mediated synthesis of ZnO nanoparticles is an efficient and simple method to obtain nanoparticles with controlled particle size.
the size of the ZnO nanoparticles is the most important parameter in determining their antimicrobial and anti biofilm activity.
the polyol mediated synthesis method is simple, cost effective and can be easily scaled up.
